honest_caveats: Spike scope: match_runner (PRIMARY) wired; the match_engine/match_state SECONDARY mirror (Tron-as-opponent-of-an-SB-plan-deck) is NOT wired in this spike -- those bo3 paths keep the legacy gate-OFF planeswalker behavior. The two production SB-plan decks (izzet-prowess-tokyo, izzet-looting) are Standard, so Modern Tron is not seated against them in normal gauntlets; impact is nil for the Tron anchor but the mirror remains TODO for a full ship.

Tron's one-shot main_phase_match Karn/Ugin blocks were left intact (gate-OFF byte-identical, NR-3a). Gate-ON they run ALONGSIDE the loyalty ticks, so Karn-the-Great-Creator's 'wish' is modeled twice (once as the cast-time draw, once as the -2 loyalty tick) -- a mild value double-count inside the gate-ON number. Honest open imperfection; the full ship should replace the one-shots with registry ticks (design 1.5).
Ultimate handlers are board-defining approximations (Karn -14 = exile opp nonland permanents; Ugin -X = fixed UGIN_X_APPROX=4 sweep), not card-accurate magnitudes (design 5.2 deferred).

Default attack-the-walker heuristic: one unblocked attacker per walker, highest-loyalty-first, only when the attack is not lethal to the face. Simple and two-sided (combat_deaths>0 confirms), not an optimal pilot model.
